latest.title: Assessing Nonlinear Elimination Preconditioning for Trust-Region Phase-Field Fracture
latest.abstract: Each quasi-static load step of phase-field fracture is a bound-constrained minimization of a nonconvex, coupled displacement-damage energy under an irreversibility bound on the damage. Monolithic Newton stalls once the nonlinearity localizes at the advancing crack front, and staggered (alternate-minimization) schemes converge slowly there. We present an on-demand nonlinear-elimination preconditioned trust-region Newton method: an energy Steihaug-Toint trust region, a primal-dual active set for irreversibility, and a bound-constrained field-split sweep that eliminates an algebraically-identified "hard set" spanning both fields before each step. The elimination is applied on demand -- triggered by the coupled Newton's own stalling and otherwise skipped -- so the method reduces to monolithic Newton at no surcharge where the step is already healthy. We find the robustness to come from the energy trust region: with that globalization fixed, monolithic Newton already completes every loading history without cutbacks, where residual-merit Newton death-spirals, alternate minimization stalls, and the full-field sweep loses robustness. Against that well-globalized baseline, the on-demand elimination cuts outer nonlinear iterations by 19-25% (brittle) and 17% (ductile), with always-on elimination reaching 26-28% and about $39\%$ at the ductile nucleation step. Measured machine-independently, as a full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work proxy rather than wall-clock, it is competitive with -- not faster than -- monolithic Newton (within about 10%), whereas an always-on sweep adds up to 30%. Nonlinear elimination is thus an iteration-reduction mechanism whose overhead the on-demand gate bounds, with no demonstrated total-work advantage over well-globalized monolithic Newton.
latest.workSummary: 论文评估相场断裂的 on-demand nonlinear-elimination trust-region Newton 求解器。每个准静态载荷步被写成带 damage irreversibility bound 的 displacement–damage 能量最小化；外层采用 Steihaug–Toint trust region 和 primal–dual active set，非线性消元只在耦合 Newton 由 crack-front hard set 引起停滞时触发，并用 KKT residual merit 做 sweep safeguard。作者在 AT1、AT2 脆性和强耦合延性 E-P-PD 试验上比较 MONO、MSPIN 与 NEPIN，报告 outer nonlinear iterations 减少，但 full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work 与 well-globalized monolithic Newton 近似持平。
techniques: 能量 merit 的 Steihaug–Toint trust region
primal–dual active set 处理不可逆约束
KKT residual merit 的 sweep safeguard
latest.breakthrough: 实验表明把 nonlinear elimination 由每步强制调用改为基于单调收敛率和 trust-region rejection 的 on-demand gate，可以在保持能量 trust-region 稳健性的同时减少 17–25% 外层迭代，并把消元额外装配开销限制在接近 monolithic Newton 的范围。
latest.limitations: 结论是固定粗网格、两个脆性正则化和一个延性试验床上的算法评估，不是一般收敛定理；full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work 没有显示总工作量优势。方法要求单一变分能量 $R=grad$ Psi，不能直接覆盖 hybrid 或外部 strength-driven 非变分模型，且本文不处理大规模自适应网格和大数据理论。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者在 Declaration of generative-AI use 中明确披露使用 Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5 和 Opus 5 协助软件实现及 comparison harness 搭建，并说明所有 AI 辅助输出均由作者审阅和验证。该用途涉及论文代码和实验基础设施，计为 explicit。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: PDF 第 27-28 页 Declaration of generative-AI use。
latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦其他分析方向，主要进展属于分析结果；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
